title: A sharp curvature lower bound for the first exterior p-harmonic Steklov eigenvalue
summary: In this paper, we study the first variational Steklov eigenvalue of the $ p$-Laplace equation on exterior domain $ Ω^{\text{ext}}$ for $ 1< p <n$. If $ Ω$ is convex and $ \partial Ω\in C^{1,1}$, we prove a sharp lower bound in terms of $p$-logarithmic mean of the principal curvatures of $ \partial Ω$. For the linear case $ p=2$, our estimate reduces to the logarithmic mean bound of Bundrock et al. (arXiv:2511.09490). We also derive an upper bound in terms of a boundary isocapacitary constant.
